mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_trace_log (trace_id, conversation_id, user_id, user_query, intent, sub_agent, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, self_score, status, error_message) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{userQuery}, #{intent}, #{subAgent}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{selfScore}, #{status}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_trace_log SET self_score = #{selfScore} WHERE trace_id = #{traceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE status != 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_message WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT AVG(self_score) FROM ai_trace_log WHERE self_score IS NOT NULL
SELECT AVG(latency_ms) FROM ai_trace_log WHERE latency_ms > 0
SELECT sub_agent AS agent, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_trace_log WHERE sub_agent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sub_agent ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN self_score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent, SUM(CASE WHEN self_score >= 6 AND self_score < 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good, SUM(CASE WHEN self_score >= 4 AND self_score < 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fair, SUM(CASE WHEN self_score < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poor FROM ai_trace_log WHERE self_score IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_trace_log SET user_feedback = #{userFeedback} WHERE trace_id = #{traceId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.trace_id FROM ai_trace_log t INNER JOIN ai_message m ON t.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND t.user_query = (SELECT m2.content FROM ai_message m2 WHERE m2.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND m2.role = 'user' AND m2.id < m.id ORDER BY m2.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE m.id = #{messageId} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
